task.title: Historical decisions on action pinning and dispatch input handling

events.content: Chose full-SHA action pinning with major-version comments

raw.question: How should publish-workflow action references be constrained?
raw.chosen: Use full commit SHA pins and retain major-version comments
raw.reasoning: The credential-bearing release workflow must not resolve mutable action tags at runtime.

events.content: Chose one-time package/dry_run validation with mapped downstream outputs

raw.question: How should package and dry_run inputs reach shell steps?
raw.chosen: Validate once, export safe outputs, and consume only mapped values downstream
raw.reasoning: Choice/boolean dispatch inputs must not be interpolated into shell source or paths.

events.content: Self-reported, non-gating session note: the agent stated that action refs and dispatch input paths were hardened. Historical commit/file metadata exists, but the record captured no command or output evidence and does not establish test, actionlint, or Node 22 results.
